verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official SigNoz-published SDK for building against the platform. Instrumentation relies on standard OpenTelemetry SDKs, which come from a third-party ecosystem rather than SigNoz itself. Service-account API access, Agent Skills, and the MCP server are adjacent capabilities that belong to other stories, and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
